question: A grocer mixes two varieties of tea priced at ₹80/kg and ₹85/kg in a certain ratio to produce a new variety priced at ₹82/kg. What is the ratio in which the two varieties were mixed to obtain the new variety?
solution:
**Given:**

Rate of 1st variety of tea = Rs.80/kg

Rate of 2nd variety of tea = Rs.85/kg

Rate of mixture of 2 varieties of tea = Rs.82/kg

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fb06a28949c54e1d36275d04763a3d852d30e347b3dc112d22e32c7b53880c4a.png] 

Quantity of 1st variety : quantity of 2nd variety = 3 : 2

**∴ The correct option is 4.**
